subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir intended to annoy Ilvara as his entire plan.
source_quote: I'm just gonna try annoying her then.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes the moment of holding something without letting go is what he came to the monastery for.
source_quote: That moment. That is the thing I came to the monastery for, even if I did not know it when I arrived, even if I spent the first three years thinking I was there to learn to fight.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir felt something warm and undignified move through his chest after landing a second critical strike.
source_quote: I recall something warm and undignified moving through my chest that I chose not to name.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir knew he was frightened by Ilvara's psychic attack.
source_quote: The fear was immediate and specific and entirely unwanted.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir understood that the frightened condition meant he should not approach Ilvara.
source_quote: The spirit seems to be that I should do nothing to become closer to her.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir decided to stay where he was, frightened and grounded, because monastic training required honest application of rules even against his own interest.
source_quote: I am supposed to apply the rule honestly, even against my own interest. That is the monastic training operating at the level of self-adjudication...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir felt it was appropriate to say 'Thanks, buddy' to the heart fungus after taking damage.
source_quote: I said it quietly. I doubt anyone heard. It felt like the appropriate response — dry, clipped, and entirely sincere in its lack of sentiment.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir did not intend to remain hovering at the ceiling while others fought.
source_quote: It was not where I intended to be.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wants to walk up to problems and hit them with Dawnbringer.
source_quote: I am, in my heart, a dwarf who wants to walk up to the problem and apply Dawnbringer to it until the problem stops.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized Dawnbringer was already the answer he needed.
source_quote: The answer I was looking for had been at the end of my arm the entire time.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt the heart fungus deserved a longer fight than it got.
source_quote: It had been a fine-looking icon. Big. Pulsing. Lovingly rendered. It deserved a longer fight than it got.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin intended to check on Glabbagool after the battle.
source_quote: I filed that away. I would be checking on Glabbagool when this was over.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin recognized Jorlan's cry of 'ILVARA' as something uglier and more honest than rage.
source_quote: It came out like a wound reopening. Not rage exactly — rage is clean, rage has direction. This was something uglier and more honest than rage.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin considered letting Jorlan pass because it was the sensible thing to do.
source_quote: Eight on the die. Eight says I do the sensible thing.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin admitted he had no useful purchase on drow politics and heartbreak.
source_quote: I do not understand six layers of drow politics wrapped around a heartbreak, and I am not ashamed to say so.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt relieved someone else was handling Ilvara.
source_quote: I'm just sitting here watching them trade blows like a tennis match. Sometimes the most useful thing a fighter can do is stay out of someone else's reckoning.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum felt the insect swarm’s sound bypassed his thinking brain and triggered a primal urge to run.
source_quote: I felt the swarm before I saw it. A wall of noise, of biting, chittering fury, the kind of sound that bypasses the thinking part of the brain and goes straight to the older, smaller part that just says *run*.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum did not run from the insect swarm.
source_quote: I did not run. I want to note that.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum was deeply concerned about Glabbagool taking twenty-six points of damage.
source_quote: Twenty-six points. We had not brought a gelatinous cube this far through the Underdark to lose him to biting insects conjured by a woman who had traded her dignity to a fungal demon lord.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed Bahamut rewards the protection of the vulnerable, even if gelatinous cubes weren't what the Platinum Dragon had in mind.
source_quote: Bahamut rewards the protection of the vulnerable. I'm not certain gelatinous cubes were what the Platinum Dragon had in mind. But I took notes on the principle, and the principle applies.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realized the fallen fungal servants belonged to Ilvara, not to the party.
source_quote: We used to have so many people traveling with us," I said, "I forgot.

subject: Grygum's Revivify spell
fact: Grygum considered using his Revivify spell to bring back a fallen minion, but did not specify which one or whether he would follow through.
source_quote: If anybody is too saddened by the loss of any of our minions, I do have a Revivify spell that I could use to bring one of them back.
